name: Activation creates table; uninstall removes all data; deactivation does nothing destructive
query: On plugin activation, create a custom database table 'my_plugin_log'. On uninstall (when the plugin is deleted), drop the table and delete all plugin options. On deactivation, do not remove any data.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run detect_wpboilerplate.mjs to confirm isWPBoilerplate: true
Step 2: Consult references/lifecycle.md to understand where each lifecycle action belongs
Step 3: In includes/Activator.php::activate(), add $wpdb table creation logic and dbDelta() call
Step 4: In includes/Deactivator.php::deactivate(), add only lightweight cleanup — do NOT drop the table or delete options
Step 5: In uninstall.php (after the WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN guard), add $wpdb->query DROP TABLE and delete_option() calls
Step 6: Confirm uninstall.php already has: if ( ! defined('WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN') ) exit;
Step 7: Do NOT add data deletion to the deactivation hook
success_criteria: Table creation is in Activator::activate(), not in Deactivator or uninstall.php
Deactivator::deactivate() contains only lightweight cleanup (cron clearing, transients) — no data deletion
Data removal (DROP TABLE, delete_option) is in uninstall.php only
Clear separation between deactivation (reversible) and uninstall (destructive)
